description:
You are the site administrator for 'Urban Electronics'. Prepare the store for launch by configuring the site identity and creating essential content pages.

1. Site Identity:
   - Set Site Name to: 'Urban Electronics'
   - Set Slogan to: 'Premium Tech, Unbeatable Prices'
   - Set the Default Front Page to: '/products'

2. Create Content Pages (Basic Page type):
   - 'Return Policy' (URL alias: /return-policy)
     Body text must contain: "Items may be returned within 30 days of purchase for a full refund. Products must be in original packaging and unused condition. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days."
   - 'Shipping Information' (URL alias: /shipping-info)
     Body text must contain: "We offer free standard shipping on all orders over $50. Standard delivery takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping is available for $12.99 with 2-3 business day delivery."
   - Both pages must be Published.

3. Main Navigation:
   - Add the following links to the 'Main navigation' menu:
     - 'Shop' -> /products
     - 'Return Policy' -> /return-policy
     - 'Shipping Information' -> /shipping-info
     - 'Contact Us' -> /contact
